adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the payload `reqBody.keys` is decrypted and `JSON.parse`d into `keys`, then written directly to `prisma.credential.update/create` as `data: { key: keys }` without any validation against an app-specific credential schema (only `appStoreMetadata` is consulted for `slug`/`type`). This allows malformed or wrong-shaped data to be persisted and potentially break later consumers at runtime.
